settings.heading: Before you *join*
settings.text: Anything not here, write to us and you hear back within a working day.

settings.question: Do I need an audience first?
settings.answer: No. A list of past clients is enough for a first round of five to ten people. Week four covers where else to find them.

settings.question: How much time does it take?
settings.answer: About two hours a week: one short lesson, one exercise and the Thursday call.

settings.question: What exactly do I get?
settings.answer: Twelve short lessons, templates for the outline, the sales page and the emails, six live calls and their recordings.

settings.question: What happens on the free call?
settings.answer: You tell us what you do and who for. We tell you honestly whether the course fits. If it does not, there is no pitch.

settings.question: When does the next round start?
settings.answer: On the first Monday of the month. Change this to your own dates.

settings.question: Can I get a refund?
settings.answer: Yes. Within 30 days of joining, for any reason, write to us and you get your money back.

settings.question: Is it live or recorded?
settings.answer: Both. Lessons are recorded so you watch when it suits you. The Thursday calls are live and recorded.

settings.question: Do I need special software?
settings.answer: No. A video call app and a document editor are enough. The templates open in any of them.

settings.question: Can I join from any time zone?
settings.answer: Yes. Calls are at a set time, and the recording is up the same day.
